thought.text: Let me reproduce the 030 workflow manually to determine if it's an app defect or data artifact.

reasoning_content:
The test failure was because `fp-9901` checkbox not found. The page lists ressorts via DienstStelle::getDienstStellenTree(). 9901 exists. Actually the issue: when 9901 already had a fachplanung (from a previous test run in the same DB, during the 01 infra spec, only ressorts/users are created; no fachplanung). Wait — but the 030 test found `fp-9901` missing. Let me check by fetching the page as r1 after creating 2027 gesamtplan. Actually the test creates 2027 first. Then goes to neue-fachplanungen/2027.

Hmm, but in the full ordered run, after 01 created ressorts 99/9901, 030 test 1 created 2027 gesamtplan, then test 2 goes to neue-fachplanungen/2027 and looks for fp-9901. Why missing? Let me actually fetch the page.

This might be a genuine app issue, or the numbering: getDienstStellenTree might only include ressorts with fk_ressort null and their bereiche. 9901 has fk_ressort=99. Should appear as bereich.

But wait - the standalone run of 030 failed too (with setup-docu-data). Let me fetch the actual page HTML to see.

Actually note: setup-docu-data deletes years >= 2027 and deletes dienststelle 9901/99. Then 030 test1 creates 2027. But 9901 doesn't exist because setup-docu-data deleted it! In a standalone run of 030, $is_partial_run is true so it recreates 99/9901. Wait, is_partial_run checks argv contains 'cypress/e2e/' and not '01-infrastruktur...'. When run via docker directly without args, $GLOBALS['argv'] contains only 'scripts/setup_docu_data.php' -> argv_string won't contain cypress path, so is_partial_run = false! So 99/9901 not recreated. That's my invocation artifact — the documented `ddev cypress` passes specs to setup... actually no, setup-docu-data command runs `ddev exec php scripts/setup_docu_data.php` with no args.

Hmm, in the full-run I did run setup-docu-data which deleted 99/9901, then 01 recreates them. So in full run, 9901 exists. Yet 030 test2 still failed to find fp-9901.

Let me look more carefully. Actually in my full run the failure detail for 030 was different: `.alert.alert-info.mb-4.d-none` not visible, at line 39. That's the test's own assertion problem — the template has `d-none` so alert-info is hidden by default and JS reveals it. So test 030 line 39 expects alert-info visible after clicking. Hmm.

But in standalone run the failure was fp-9901 not found at line 33. That's because 9901 didn't exist (is_partial_run false).

So these are test-harness/data issues, not app install defects. The documented `ddev cypress run` uses the host command with SPECS but does NOT call setup_docu_data (it's commented out!). Actually the host cypress script has setup_docu_data commented out. And guide says the combined command resets DB. Hmm the guide text says "der kombinierte Befehl genutzt werden, der vor jedem Test-Lauf die Datenbank automatisch zurücksetzt" but in the script it's commented out. That's a repo inconsistency, not install.

Let me verify the app actually can run the workflow manually via curl to establish operational status. The core functions: login works (r1/r2/r3), user management works (02 passed), LDAP search works, ressorts render. The 030 test line 39 failure is about an alert-info. Let me reproduce manually: fetch /administration/it-gesamtplan after 2027 created, then the neue-fachplanungen page.

Let me actually check the page HTML to see if fp-9901 exists when 9901 exists.
